title: Restoring the oracle configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a Boolean oracle Turing machine and $C$ a Boolean multitape Turing machine with $c>0$ work tapes, and choose states $en,ex$ of $C$. Let $c_0$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$, with side tag $b$ and a Boolean verdict $v$. Suppose $c_0$ is nonhalting and its query-tape head position $p$ satisfies $p\ge0$ when $b=\mathrm{true}$ and $p\le0$ when $b=\mathrm{false}$. Starting from the host's dispatch encoding of the ready configuration whose query tape is that of $c_0$, whose head is at $p$, and whose argument tape contains the one-symbol word $[v]$, after $|p|+4$ steps the host is in the stable encoding of the configuration obtained from $c_0$ by setting its state to the positive-answer state of $M$ if $v$ is true and to its negative-answer state otherwise, for some side tag $b'$; the resulting query-tape head position satisfies the corresponding side condition for $b'$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean oracle machine M and Boolean multitape machine C
chosen entry and exit states en, ex
orientation condition on c₀'s query-tape head position
